title: LoadProhibited with EXCVADDR 0x00000008
serial_logs:
Guru Meditation Error: Core  1 panic'ed (LoadProhibited). Exception was unhandled.
Core  1 register dump:
PC      : 0x400d2b6e  PS      : 0x00060830  A0      : 0x800d2c10
EXCVADDR: 0x00000008
Backtrace: 0x400d2b6b:0x3ffb8f50 0x400d2c0d:0x3ffb8f70
  #0  report_task at main/report.c:12

reference_context.title: ESP-IDF Programming Guide (Espressif)
reference_context.snippet: These CPU exceptions happen when an application attempts to read from or write to an invalid memory location. The address which has been written/read is found in the ``EXCVADDR`` register in the register dump. If this address is zero, it usually means that the application has attempted to dereference a NULL pointer.

expected.root_cause: report_task dereferences r->ts while last is still NULL (before the first sample); offset 8 of a NULL struct pointer gives EXCVADDR 0x8.
expected.fix: Check for NULL before dereferencing (or wait until the first sample is available).
